conf.description: Building Automation (Metasys) audit syslog-csv direct route: RFC3164 envelope + documented positional pipe-delimited Audit Viewer record parse, dash-to-null restoration, host disambiguation between the DDA server and the audited engine

conf.comment: Metasys Syslog DDA: one BSD frame per Audit Repository entry, MSG = When|Item|ClassLevel|OriginApp|User|ActionType|Description|PreviousValue|PostValue|Status, '-' for empty columns, fixed Facility 13/Severity 6. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists for Metasys.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and documented MSG grammar
Split the RFC3164 envelope (HOSTNAME = the ADS/ADX/OAS server running the DDA) from the pipe-delimited audit content (MSG)
Positional split of the ten documented Audit Viewer columns on the vertical bar
Restore '-' (Metasys' empty-column marker) to unset before anything downstream shapes these fields

Item's deviceHostname segment goes to observer.name (not host.name - Header hostname already formally claims host.name and is a different real host, the DDA-emitting server, not the audited engine); postData-style client IP promoted to source.ip only for log-in/log-out Action Types; event.outcome cross-checks Status against Action Type/Description since Status is frequently '-'; PRI Facility/Severity are fixed constants per the DDA spec, not parsed
Batch rename of the directly-mapped columns, run after the eval above so observer.name/source.ip/event.outcome could still read the original m_item/m_postvalue/m_status
Event time from the body When column, preferred over the BSD header which carries no year (platform constraint: never target @timestamp)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop staging fields consumed into their ECS/custom targets above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
